tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Pocket Pothi's verified Hindu prayer texts by name, alias, first line or a phrase (Devanagari or English letters), deity or type. Returns ids, titles and page URLs; use fetch or get_text for the full text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the full verified text of one prayer by id (from search): every verse in Devanagari with simple Roman spelling. Quote it exactly.

tools.name: list_texts
tools.description: List the catalog, optionally filtered by deity or type. Returns ids, titles, type, language, verse count and links (no full text).

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Full verified text of one prayer, in Devanagari, simple Roman (English letters), or both. Use for recitation help or when the user reads only one script.

tools.name: make_pothi_link
tools.description: Build a short pocketpothi.com link that opens several prayers in the given order, to read in one scroll or send to family (e.g. on WhatsApp). Nothing is saved; the link encodes the order.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Public sink: make_pothi_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Public sink: make_pothi_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
